reason: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:126-143, DualWriterMode3.Update passes the caller's original objInfo directly to d.Legacy.Update inside an unawaited goroutine (line 139) instead of wrapping the Storage.Update result in updateWrapper. Because LegacyStorage.Update implementations such as pkg/registry/apis/playlist/legacy_storage.go:141-146 fetch legacy's own old object and call objInfo.UpdatedObject(ctx, old), the update logic (such as patches, SSA, or transformers) is re-applied against legacy's state after Update returns and can produce a different object than unified storage stored.
